  CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
 NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that pursuant to Government Code Section 54956, by delivery of this
 written notice as provided by law, the Mayor has called a special meeting of the Lomita City
 Council. Pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 issued on March 17, 2020, this
 meeting will be held via teleconference only and no physical location from which members of
 the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided.

 Access to the meeting will be available via URL: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84796639379 or by
 calling (669) 900 6833 Zoom meeting ID: 847 9663 9379

  AGENDA
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 17, 2021
  3:15 P.M.
  VARIOUS TELECONFERENCE LOCATIONS

1. OPENING CEREMONIES

  a) Call Meeting to Order
  b) Flag Salute
  c) Roll Call

2. PUBLIC COMMENTS
  Persons wishing to speak on agenda items are requested to do so at this time. Government
  Code Section 54954.2 prohibits the Council from discussing or taking action on a specific item
  unless it appears on a posted agenda.

  SCHEDULED ITEMS

3. 2021 GOAL SETTING PLANNING SESSION

  Presented by Ryan Smoot, City Manager

  RECOMMENDED ACTION: Discuss and provide direction.

  Page 1 of 2
 Lomita City Council Special Meeting Agenda  March 17, 2021

4. ADJOURNMENT

  I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the
  foregoing agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting at the following
  locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and
  uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.

  In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance
  to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at (310) 325-7110
  (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable
  the City to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.

  Date Posted: March 15, 2021

  ________________________________
  Kathleen Horn Gregory, CMC, City Clerk
